title: Admin user-detail history separation
implementationState: Approved on 2026-10-11 and implemented based on b3c71fd and committed with this guide. Exact-commit independent review and hosted checks pending.

requirements.expectation: Agree the four-query read-only extraction and review criteria before implementation.

requirements.expectation: The route uses typed history operations; the server-only admin read model owns its client internally, stays below 300 lines and exposes no SDK client/result types.
evidence: 58-line server-only admin/user-history.ts owns its client and returns Promise<Record<string, unknown>[]> operations. Route contains no table calls or service client factory. Typecheck passed.

requirements.expectation: Preserve projections, both-role filters, descending creation order and history limits of 50/30/30/20.
requirements.verification: Baseline comparison and unchanged route characterization assertions.
evidence: 24 route tests passed against the original implementation and unchanged after extraction; assertions preserve projections, both-role filters, order and 50/30/30/20 limits. Source comparison confirms four query chains are preserved.

requirements.expectation: Preserve response fields, empty defaults, data-plus-returned-error semantics and generic thrown-error responses.
requirements.verification: Characterization tests including all four history failure paths.
evidence: Baseline/after tests cover all four thrown history failures and each returned-error empty/partial-data result. Existing response, null defaults and shared-profile error precedence preserved.

requirements.expectation: Configuration/admin/shared-profile guards precede history client creation; all seven secondary operations remain concurrent.
requirements.verification: Guard and deferred-query tests plus source comparison.
evidence: 24 baseline/after tests include auth/config guards, history-client noncreation after missing/error shared profile, separate identity/history clients and deferred-status verification that all secondary queries start concurrently.

requirements.expectation: Baseline and after tests, full test suite, typecheck, lint with zero errors and diff checks pass; no protected/schema/config/UI changes.
